Reported failures carry a stable code alongside the message. The code does not change when the wording does, so it is safe to match on.

## General

| Code | Constant |
|---|---|
| `INTERNAL_UNEXPECTED` | `General.InternalUnexpected` |

## Configuration

| Code | Constant |
|---|---|
| `CONFIG_INVALID` | `Configuration.Invalid` |
| `CONFIG_MISSING` | `Configuration.Missing` |
